# Phone Tool

**Author:** Infineon Technologies Denmark A/S<br/>
**Platforms:** APOXI

<div className="screenshot">

![Phone Tool: screenshot 1](./phone-tool/img/phone-tool.png)

</div>

Infineon's official service framework for phones based on the APOXI platform. Includes EEPROM and file system editors, tools for calibrating the RF path, audio parameters, power and charging, a terminal, and diagnostic tests.

## Versions

- **50.00** — [phone-tool-50.00.zip](https://git.siepatch.dev/siepatch/soft/media/branch/main/catalog/service/phone-tool/files/phone-tool-50.00.zip) (2008-05-28)<br/>Windows 32-bit · 5.84 MiB
